article.story: MOREHEAD, Ky. -- — Chase Dawson scored 23 points as Morehead State beat IU Indianapolis 79-75 on Saturday. Dawson shot 8 for 12 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Eagles (2-2). Kenyata Carbon scored 15 points while shooting 4 of 9 from the field and 7 for 7 from the foul line, and added five rebounds. Dalman Alexander finished 4 of 7 from the floor to finish with 10 points. Peyton Heiss finished with 21 points for the Jaguars (3-1). Manasseh Stackhouse added 11 points, 10 rebounds, two steals and two blocks for IU Indianapolis. Billy Smith also had 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
